method: Use the eight live-origin observations in collector.json once each. Median is the mean of the two central sorted values. P95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95 * n). Timeout count includes unavailable timeout results; fault-injection records are excluded.
interpretation: The observed diagnostic sample stays below the proposed per-call and p95 limits. The eight cases are synthetic and unreviewed; this does not measure manager-only or deterministic comparators, establish a production timeout rate, authenticate invoice spend, or qualify a delegated action.
